policies.source_title: Segye Ilbo — 경남도·창원시, 방산 전용 AI 데이터센터 투자협약 (28 Jul 2026)

policies.title: Seoul district heads' resolution to restrict data centres in general residential zones
policies.jurisdiction: Seoul district heads (association of district heads)
key_terms: 이 안건은 참석 구청장들의 만장일치로 의결됐다
제2·3종 일반주거지역 데이터센터 건립 제한해야

items: This agenda item was approved unanimously by the attending district heads.
Data-centre construction should be restricted in Type 2 and Type 3 general residential zones

policies.summary: Herald Economy (15 August 2026) reports that the attending Seoul district heads unanimously approved an agenda item to restrict data-centre construction in Type 2 and Type 3 general residential zones. It is a resolution of the district heads, not a rule; taking effect would need a Seoul city ordinance and related legal changes.
policies.source_title: Herald Economy — Seoul district heads' resolution on data centres in residential zones (15 Aug 2026)

policies.title: NITI Aayog framework for evaluating data-centre proposals
key_terms: The framework proposes that States link data centre approvals to verified electricity, water and infrastructure availability
policies.summary: GKToday reports that the NITI Aayog Frontier Tech Hub framework, released on 14 October 2026, proposes that States link data-centre approvals to verified electricity, water and infrastructure availability. Other outlets describe it as guidance for States, not a new national approval rule. The NITI Aayog document itself was not read.
policies.source_title: GKToday — NITI Aayog links data centre approvals to power and water

policies.title: North Wales AI Growth Zone (Prosperity Parc, Anglesey; Trawsfynydd, Gwynedd)
key_terms: North Wales in line for more than 3,400 new jobs through newly announced AI Growth Zone
policies.summary: The UK government's 13 November 2025 release confirms a North Wales AI Growth Zone straddling the Menai Strait, with bases at Prosperity Parc on Anglesey and Trawsfynydd in Gwynedd. It says the zone is in line for more than 3,400 new jobs, a government figure rather than a committed community benefit. The release says work is under way to secure an investment partner, with construction to follow once a deal is confirmed.
policies.source_title: GOV.UK — AI Growth Zones to create thousands of jobs: new site confirmed for North Wales (13 Nov 2025)

policies.title: Jeju Development Center public AI data centre (Jeju Advanced Science & Technology Complex 2)
key_terms: 주민 우려가 제기되면 사업 필요성을 설명하고 협의할 방침이다.

items: If residents raise concerns, JDC plans to explain the project's necessity and consult with them.

policies.summary: Fnnews reports that the Jeju Free International City Development Center (JDC) briefed on 28 August 2026 a public AI data centre of 30 MW and 392.1 billion won, targeted for the second half of 2028. The project is under consideration, with SK and KT in talks. The article gives no jobs figure for this centre.
policies.source_title: Fnnews — JDC Jeju public AI data centre briefing (31 Aug 2026)
counterparties: Jeju Free International City Development Center (JDC)

policies.title: Busan–Egis Asset Management AI data centre investment MOU (Myeongji-Noksan)

items: Priority hiring of new personnel needed for data centre operations from local talent, and

policies.summary: TWIG24 reports Busan City's press release on an investment MOU signed 17 June 2025 with Egis Asset Management for two large AI data centres, stated at 1.8 trillion won. The MOU sets priority local hiring for operations and priority participation for local construction firms. It is an investment MOU, not a binding agreement.
policies.source_title: TWIG24 — Busan City and Egis AI data centre MOU (18 Jun 2025)

policies.title: Uttar Pradesh Data Centre Policy 2026
key_terms: The Policy notified vide G.O. No. 536/78-2-2026/E-105226 dated 09.07.2026
50% Land subsidy on prevailing sector rates shall be provided on purchase/lease of land from State Agencies in Bundelkhand and Purvanchal regions
policies.summary: The Government of Uttar Pradesh notified its Data Centre Policy 2026 by a G.O. dated 9 July 2026, from the Department of IT & Electronics. Clause 7.1.3 offers a 50% land subsidy on purchases or leases from State agencies in the Bundelkhand and Purvanchal regions, against 25% in the other regions. The policy's own text states these incentives; community-benefit terms were not found in the text read.
policies.source_title: Government of Uttar Pradesh — Data Centre Policy 2026 (G.O. dated 9 Jul 2026)

policies.title: Ofgem Curate consultation: data centre connection reforms
key_terms: Data centre projects above a 40 MW threshold will be required to secure a returnable financial commitment
policies.summary: Ofgem's 29 July 2026 consultation proposes that data centre projects above 40 MW secure a returnable financial commitment to join the demand-connection queue, at about £237,500 to £712,500 per MW of requested capacity. Responses were due 16 September 2026 and a decision is expected by the end of 2026. It is a consultation, not a rule in force.
policies.source_title: Ofgem — Proposed data centre connection reforms (Curate) consultation document (29 Jul 2026)

policies.title: CRE approval of RTE 400 kV "fast track" connection procedure (very large consumers)
key_terms: permet d’accélérer le raccordement, à horizon 2028-2029, des consommateurs de très forte puissance (entre 400 MW et 1 GW) au réseau très haute tension (400 kV) de RTE

items: It allows the connection, by 2028-2029, of very high-power consumers (between 400 MW and 1 GW) to RTE's very high-voltage (400 kV) network to be accelerated.

policies.summary: France's energy regulator CRE approved on 7 May 2025 an alternative 'fast track' procedure for connecting consumers of 400 MW to 1 GW to RTE's 400 kV grid, targeting 2028-2029 on sites identified by the State. The release names data centres only as an example; the procedure is not specific to them.
policies.source_title: CRE — Communiqué: procédure fast track de raccordement (7 May 2025)

policies.title: Ishikari Data Centre Consortium (石狩DCC), established by the City of Ishikari
key_terms: 「地域の計算資源」かつ「社会インフラ」と位置づけ
DC間での人材交流、雇用の創出を推進するほか

items: The consortium positions data centres as 'regional computing resources' and 'social infrastructure'.
The consortium will promote engineer training, staff exchange between data centres, and job creation, in addition to building local understanding among residents and local firms.

policies.summary: The City of Ishikari's 28 July 2026 release establishes a consortium of data-centre operators. It says the consortium will promote staff exchange and job creation and build local understanding, with no job number given. Participants are listed as planned, not confirmed, and the consortium sets no obligations on operators.
policies.source_title: City of Ishikari — 石狩データセンターコンソーシアム設立 (news release, 28 Jul 2026)

policies.title: Plan de Interés General de Aragón (PIGA) 'Implantación de la Región Microsoft en Aragón', ORDEN FOM/1520/2025
key_terms: El Plan tiene como objeto la implantación e interconexión de tres campus de Centros de Datos en Aragón, en los municipios de La Muela, Villamayor de Gállego y Zaragoza

items: The Plan's purpose is the implementation and interconnection of three data-centre campuses in Aragón, in the municipalities of La Muela, Villamayor de Gállego and Zaragoza.

policies.summary: Aragón's regional government gave initial approval on 14 November 2025 to a plan promoted by Microsoft 7724 Spain for three data-centre campuses in La Muela, Villamayor de Gállego and Zaragoza. It is an initial approval only; the final approval had not been confirmed.
policies.source_title: Gobierno de Aragón — PIGA Región Microsoft

policies.title: Plan de Interés General de Aragón (PIGA) 'Proyecto Rhodes', Calatorao, ORDEN FOM/1039/2025
key_terms: Mediante Orden de 19 de agosto de 2025 del Consejero de Fomento, Vivienda, Logística y Cohesión Territorial ha sido aprobado inicialmente el citado Plan de Interés General de Aragón
El Plan tiene como finalidad el desarrollo de un campus data center en el término municipal de Calatorao (Zaragoza).

items: By Order of 19 August 2025 of the Councillor for Works, Housing, Logistics and Territorial Cohesion, the cited Aragón General Interest Plan has been initially approved.
The Plan's purpose is the development of a data-centre campus in the municipality of Calatorao (Zaragoza).

policies.summary: Aragón's regional government declared the 'Proyecto Rhodes' data-centre campus in Calatorao an investment of general interest on 14 October 2024, naming Calanza Inmuebles, S.L. as promoter, and gave the plan initial approval by order of 19 August 2025. It is an initial approval only; no definitive approval appears on the page.
policies.source_title: Gobierno de Aragón — Proyecto Rhodes (PIGA, Calatorao)

policies.title: Karnataka Sustainable Data Centre Policy 2026-2031
key_terms: targets 1 GW of cumulative data centre IT load by 2031
Units achieving a PUE of 1.00 to 1.20 can receive Rs 20 crore as one-time financial support.
policies.summary: Karnataka's Cabinet approved the policy on 18 September 2026, per Deccan Chronicle. It targets 1 GW of cumulative data-centre IT load by 2031 and offers a one-time incentive for units that hold a low power usage effectiveness (PUE) for three consecutive years. Both sources are press reports; the government order and policy text were not found, so the terms are as reported.
policies.source_title: The News Minute — Karnataka's new data centre policy puts water, energy in focus

resources.title: Deccan Chronicle — Karnataka approves Sustainable Data Centre Policy 2026-31

policies.title: Maharashtra Data Centre Policy (proposed, with SOPs)
key_terms: The MPCB and IIT Bombay are working on guidelines covering environmental impact, zoning and resource use.
policies.summary: Free Press Journal reported on 7 September 2026 that Maharashtra is preparing a data-centre policy, expected to be finalised in a few months, with guidelines from the state pollution board and IIT Bombay. It is a pending instrument, not a notified policy.
policies.source_title: Free Press Journal — Maharashtra to soon have a data centre policy

policies.title: Greater Noida data-centre plot allotment scheme (GNIDA)
key_terms: the process will be carried out through an e-auction
policies.summary: IndiaInfraHub reported on 14 June 2023 that the Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority launched a scheme to allot 13 plots for data centres by e-auction. The authority's own notice was not fetched, so the terms are as reported.
policies.source_title: IndiaInfraHub — Greater Noida launches land allotment scheme for data centres

policies.title: YEIDA Sector 28 data-centre plot allotments, near Noida International Airport
policies.jurisdiction: Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Area, Uttar Pradesh
key_terms: Sify Infinite Spaces has been allotted land plot D-10 measuring 20,000 sq metres in Sector 28
policies.summary: Outlook Business reported on 8 November 2023 that the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority allotted data-centre plots in Sector 28 to Sify Infinite Spaces and Jackson Limited. The authority's own notice was not fetched.
policies.source_title: Outlook Business — Sify, Jackson get land for data centres near Noida airport

policies.title: CEA committee on the impact of data centres on grid stability
key_terms: The Central Electricity Authority (CEA) has constituted a committee to assess the impact of rapidly expanding data centres
policies.summary: KNN India reported on 1 October 2026 that the Central Electricity Authority set up a committee to assess data centres' effect on grid stability and related policy and regulatory issues. It is a study body, not a rule; no CEA order was fetched.
policies.source_title: KNN India — CEA sets up committee to assess data centres' impact on power grid stability

moratoriums.duration_description: Temporary pause announced in 2019; new capacity reopened through the pilot Data Centre Call for Application launched 20 July 2022
moratoriums.summary: The government informed industry of a temporary pause in data-centre growth in 2019 and began a review. EDB and IMDA launched a pilot Data Centre Call for Application on 20 July 2022 for new capacity with sustainability conditions; this record treats that launch as the end of the pause, but the release does not use the word lifted and states no day for the 2019 pause.
moratoriums.source_title: EDB and IMDA joint release — Launch of pilot Data Centre Call for Application (20 July 2022)

resources.title: EDB and IMDA joint release (20 July 2022): 'The Government informed the industry of a temporary pause in the growth of DCs in 2019'
W.Media — EDB, IMDA to launch a pilot data centre call for application: 'the Singapore government had put a moratorium in 2019 on the growth of data centres'

projects.name: Google Grange Castle data centre (Clondalkin)
projects.source_title: Newstalk — Google refused permission to build huge Dublin data centre
projects.notes: Newstalk reports Google wants to build a 72,000 square metre facility at Grange Castle Business Park near Clondalkin, and that South Dublin County Council refused planning permission in August 2024. announced_year is the year of that refusal, the earliest dated source captured. An appeal was reported by secondary sources only and is not recorded. On appeal (case PL06S.320852, planning authority reference SD24A/0164W), An Coimisiún Pleanála decided on 23 September 2026 to grant a ten-year permission with conditions for the expansion of Google Ireland Limited's operations at Grange Castle Business Park South and Profile Park; the Irish Times (28 September 2026) reports the permission is conditional and may be subject to judicial review. No construction start is recorded, so the status stays announced.

updates.title: An Coimisiún Pleanála grants permission on appeal, overturning the council's refusal
updates.summary: The Commission's case page records the outcome as 'Grant Permissions with Conditions' (case PL06S.320852) for a ten-year planning permission for a data storage facility and associated works at Grange Castle Business Park South and Profile Park, Baldonnell. The Irish Times reported the grant on 28 September 2026 and that it may be subject to judicial review.
updates.source_title: An Coimisiún Pleanála — Case reference PL06S.320852

projects.name: Nscale Loughton data centre
projects.source_title: Data Centre Review — Nscale latest to face public backlash over proposed data centre
projects.notes: Data Centre Review reports the Essex scheme received outline approval in 2024 (announced_year is that year) and that the revised scheme is 50% higher than originally proposed and includes 50% more internal capacity. The final decision lies with Epping Forest District Council. An Nscale spokesperson told The Telegraph it expects construction to begin in Q2 2026 and the site to be operational in Q2 2027.

projects.name: Segro Le Bourget data centre (former H&M warehouse)
projects.source_title: BeBeez — Mayor could block data center planned at former H&M warehouse in Le Bourget, France
projects.notes: A 75 MW data centre planned by property firm Segro at a former H&M warehouse. The newly elected mayor is demanding its cancellation. Segro says it will recover heat from 12 MW of the 75 MW used. announced_year is the year of the source article (30 June 2026), the earliest dated source captured.

updates.title: Montreuil court judge upholds the commune's withdrawal of the building permit
updates.summary: An interim-relief ruling only, reported as finding the project did not meet the local plan's height rules. The merits are undecided and Segro says it will contest.
updates.source_title: Banque des Territoires — Datacenters: les projets contestés dans la Drôme et au Bourget

projects.name: Google Beauharnois data centre
projects.source_title: Hydro-Québec newsroom — Project to expand Google's activities in Québec: future data center in Beauharnois
projects.notes: Hydro-Québec's May 2021 release describes a potential investment of US$600 million (approximately C$735 million) and close to 30 specialized jobs, on 62.4 hectares of Hydro-Québec land. No later status was found.

projects.name: Cerrillos Data Center
projects.source_title: BioBioChile — Alcaldesa de Cerrillos rechaza nuevo plan de data center de Google
projects.notes: BioBioChile reported on 17 September 2024 that Google decided not to continue its permit request for a data centre in Cerrillos and would redesign the project with air cooling at an investment of 200 million dollars; the figure refers to the redesigned plan. The mayor rejected the new plan, saying it lacked the necessary legal studies. Status rests on that article alone. announced_year is the year of the earliest dated source captured. Coordinates are the Cerrillos commune centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate. Status updated 19 October 2026: BioBioChile reports Google refiled a redesigned, air-cooled project and that the SEA Región Metropolitana ruled it need not enter the SEIA; the ruling is not a construction permit.

updates.title: Google says it will not pursue the original Cerrillos design
updates.summary: CNN Chile, citing a statement to El Mercurio, reports Google's decision not to pursue the original design and to restart the project with air cooling.
updates.source_title: CNN Chile — Google se rinde con proyecto original de data center en Cerrillos

updates.title: SEA resolves that Google's redesigned Cerrillos data centre does not need SEIA review
updates.summary: BioBioChile reports the ruling by SEA Región Metropolitana; it is not a final construction permit and other permits are still needed. The Segundo Tribunal Ambiental had partly annulled the 2020 approval in February 2024.
updates.source_title: BioBioChile — SEA resuelve que Google no debe pasar por evaluación ambiental para construir data center en Cerrillos (19 Oct 2026)

updates.title: Redesign details as reported: 44 diesel backup generators and 63 air-cooled chillers
updates.summary: BioBioChile reports the redesign includes 44 backup diesel generators and 63 air-cooled chillers that, as reported, do not require water consumption. This is the design as described, not measured data.
updates.source_title: BioBioChile — SEA resuelve que Google no debe pasar por evaluación ambiental para construir data center en Cerrillos (19 Oct 2026)

projects.name: Google Quilicura data center
projects.source_title: Google (Blog, Latinoamérica) — 10 datos sobre el centro de datos de Google en Quilicura, Chile
projects.notes: Google's blog describes the site as its first data centre in Latin America. es.wikipedia records that Google announced construction there on 6 September 2012, so announced_year is 2012. Coordinates are the Quilicura commune centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate.

projects.name: Microsoft Chile Central cloud region
projects.source_title: Microsoft News Center Latinoamérica — Microsoft inaugura su primera Región de Datacenters en Chile
projects.notes: Microsoft's release says its first cloud region in Chile, in the Santiago Metropolitan Region, is operational. About 3.3 billion dollars is to be invested directly in Chile, and Microsoft cites an estimated 81,041 jobs in 2025 to 2029; the jobs figure is a national estimate, not a count for this site. announced_year is the year of the opening release. Coordinates are the Santiago city centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate.

projects.name: AWS data centre, Bahía Blanca free-trade zone (Tango Sur / Centro / Norte)
projects.source_title: Diario Financiero (Reuters) — Argentina aprueba construcción de centro de datos de Amazon
projects.notes: Reuters, published 25 October 2019, reports AWS received authorization to build a data centre in a free-trade zone in Buenos Aires province with an estimated investment of US$800 million. No completion or withdrawal source was read. Coordinates are the Bahía Blanca city centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate.

projects.name: Project Mars, Lane Cove
projects.source_title: ACS Information Age — Controversial Sydney data centre plan scrapped
projects.notes: ACS Information Age reports Goodman's head of planning advised the NSW government that the company had formally withdrawn its development application for a proposed 90 MW data centre in Lane Cove. Planning began in March 2025 per a letter quoted by ACS. The NSW Planning Portal was not read.

projects.name: Microsoft Sandviken datacentre (three planned facilities)
projects.source_title: Microsoft Local — Growing together: How Microsoft's datacenters are empowering communities in Sandviken and Gävle
projects.notes: Microsoft's blog says the three planned facilities will create an estimated 300 permanent skilled technician jobs in Sandviken. The blog is undated; announced_year 2021 is the Sweden region announcement year from a search summary that was not probed. Construction status was not verified.

projects.name: Microsoft Finland datacentre region (Espoo and Kirkkonummi), waste heat to Fortum district heating
projects.source_title: Microsoft News Europe — Microsoft announces intent to build a new datacenter region in Finland
projects.notes: Microsoft's 17 March 2022 release says that, in collaboration with Fortum, waste heat from the datacenters will be converted to district heating serving Espoo, Kauniainen and Kirkkonummi. Update 2026-10-19: Microsoft's 28 April 2026 announcement (https://news.microsoft.com/source/emea/2026/04/microsoft-kaynnistaa-paakaupunkiseudun-datakeskusalueen-toisen-vaiheen-rakentamisen/?lang=fi) confirms the second-phase build decision for the Espoo, Kirkkonummi and Vihti data-centre area, states that first-phase construction began in late 2024, and states that building permits exist for the second phase at all three campuses. Power and investment are still not stated in the text read.

projects.name: Google Hamina data centre campus (expansion and heat-recovery project)
projects.source_title: Business Finland — Google announced an expansion of its Hamina data center and a new heat recovery project
projects.notes: Business Finland reports Google's 20 May 2024 announcement of a new €1 billion investment in expanding its Hamina campus (announced_year is the expansion year; the page also dates the campus to 2009), with heat recovery for the district-heating network. The expansion's construction status was not verified. Update 2026-10-19: a CapMan Infra release reprinted by IREI (article dated 18 May 2026) reports that the Haminan Energia heat-recovery facility was delivered within a year with first heat supplied in the fourth quarter of 2025, and that once fully operational it is expected to cover around 70-75 percent of Hamina's district heating energy. The 2024 announcement had put the figure at about 80%; both are stored as their sources state.

projects.name: Microsoft Attica data centres (Spata Site 6; Kropia Sites 27 and 28)
projects.source_title: Greek Ministry of Development — Investment in Data Centres in Greece (ependyseis portal)
projects.notes: The ministry portal lists three data-centre sites: Site 6 (19.2 MW) in Spata-Artemida and Sites 27 and 28 (9.6 MW each) in Kropia, with a budget of 976.168.800 €. The portal states no total, so power_mw is not set. Enterprise Greece describes the investment as 'several hundred million', a different scale; both are stored as their sources state. Update 2026-10-19: To Vima (2 January 2026) reports that the Spata site is part of a broader Microsoft complex of approximately 85 stremmas in Eastern Attica, with a total capacity of 25 MW and a completion target of 2028. These are press figures, not Microsoft-published, and sit alongside the ministry portal's per-site figures above.

updates.title: Enterprise Greece board reported to give a positive opinion on strategic-investment status
updates.summary: Greek business outlet powergame.gr reports that the Enterprise Greece board gave a positive opinion to the Strategic Investments Committee on placing Microsoft's 'Investment in Data Centres in Greece' plan under the strategic-investment scheme. Enterprise Greece's own page dates its board approval to 1 April 2022; the report is dated 4 April. The 2026 interministerial approval status was not verified.
updates.source_title: powergame.gr: Enterprise Greece, positive opinion on Microsoft's project (4 Apr 2022, in Greek)

projects.name: Google Waltham Cross data centre (Hertfordshire)
projects.source_title: Google — Our new Waltham Cross data center is part of our two-year, £5 billion investment to help power the UK's AI economy (16 Sep 2025)
projects.notes: Google's 16 September 2025 post announces the opening of the Waltham Cross data centre as part of a two-year £5 billion UK investment; that figure is company-wide, so no site investment is stored. announced_year is 2024, the year given in the earlier wave-1 lead; the cited post itself dates the opening. A Broxbourne Council item describes the site as Cheshunt (Theobalds Business Park). Coordinates were not probed.

projects.name: Stargate Argentina (OpenAI and Sur Energy), letter of intent, site not named
projects.source_title: Sur Energy — Sur Energy and OpenAI plan Stargate Argentina (press release, 10 Oct 2025)
projects.notes: Sur Energy's release says the two companies signed a Letter of Intent for a data-centre project reaching up to 500MW, with up to $25 billion in investment at full scale. No official page names the province or site, so subdivision and coordinates are empty. Sur Energy is the developer; it is not a tracked company, so the record sits under OpenAI, the other signatory. A separate Neuquén project (Pampa Energía, 500 MW) is a different project and is not attached. OpenAI's own page returned 403 to the probe.

updates.title: Chequeado reports no progress or concrete investment a year after the announcement
updates.summary: As reported by Chequeado, the project has not formally applied to join the RIGI. An OpenAI spokesperson told the outlet that Sur Energy will lead the energy and infrastructure development and assemble the consortium for construction.
updates.source_title: Chequeado — A un año del anuncio de OpenAI y el Gobierno, no hay avances (15 Oct 2026)

projects.name: Google AI hub, Visakhapatnam (1 GW)
projects.source_title: The News Minute — Google to invest USD 15 billion in Vizag data center (14 Oct 2025)
projects.notes: Investment is the site figure: The News Minute (14 October 2025) reports a data centre in Visakhapatnam “with an investment of Rs 87,520 crore (USD 10 billion)”. The $15 billion in Google's announcement is its five-year plan for the India AI hub and is not stored as the site figure; Google's blog says Google's AI hub is powered by that $15 billion investment. Coordinates are the Visakhapatnam city centroid, not the site. Construction start: Adani Group's release dated 28 April 2026 states that Google officially broke ground on the Visakhapatnam AI hub that day, 'the start of construction', at Tarluvada. The Bar & Bench report on the NGT appeal gives Rs 17,700 crore for the hyperscale data centre park under appeal; that figure and the Rs 87,520 crore site figure may cover different scopes, and neither source reconciles them. Earlier source for this record: https://thesouthfirst.com/andhrapradesh/googles-largest-ai-hub-outside-us-coming-up-in-visakhapatnam-firm-to-invest-%E2%82%B915-billion-in-india/.

updates.title: Andhra Pradesh orders transfer of 480 acres to Adani Infra for the Google AI data centre
updates.summary: A government order issued on 2 December 2025, following a Council of Ministers meeting on 28 November 2025, permits the transfer of 480 acres in Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli districts to Adani Infra (India) Pvt Ltd, a notified partner of Google's Raiden Infotech India.
updates.source_title: Deccan Chronicle (PTI) — Andhra Govt Allots 480 Acres for Adani-Google AI Data Centre in Visakhapatnam

updates.title: Google breaks ground on the Visakhapatnam AI hub
updates.summary: A release published by Adani Group (partner AdaniConneX) states that on 28 April 2026 Google officially broke ground at Tarluvada, Andhra Pradesh, which it describes as the start of construction; the Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister and the Union IT Minister attended.
updates.authority: Google; AdaniConneX; Government of Andhra Pradesh
updates.source_title: Adani Group — Google Breaks Ground on India AI Hub, Launching a National Industrial Ecosystem

updates.title: Andhra Pradesh High Court issues notice on public-interest petition against the data centre
updates.summary: The petition, filed by environmental activist Bolisetty Satyanarayana, questions the project's Environmental Clearance and the allotment of 160 acres of temple land. The court issued notice on 1 July 2026.
updates.source_title: LiveLaw — AP High Court issues notice on PIL challenging Google-Adani data centre project

updates.title: State tells High Court it is taking steps to protect the environment at the data centre site
updates.summary: On 24 August 2026 the Andhra Pradesh government told the High Court it is taking every step to ensure construction of the Google-Adani data centres does not affect the environment. The petition seeks a halt to construction until comprehensive environmental impact studies are carried out.
updates.source_title: Bar & Bench — Google-Adani data centre will not affect environment: Andhra Pradesh government tells High Court

updates.title: Reported: National Green Tribunal seeks Centre's response to appeal against environmental clearance
updates.summary: Bar & Bench reported on 16 October 2026 that the National Green Tribunal has sought the Central government's response to a plea challenging the environmental clearance for the Google-Adani Visakhapatnam data centre project. The page does not state the date of the Tribunal's order.
updates.source_title: Bar & Bench — NGT seeks Centre's response to plea against clearance for Google-Adani's Rs 17,700 crore Vizag data centre

projects.name: Amazon data centre, Balkum, Thane
projects.source_title: Free Press Journal — Wake Up Thanekar representative opposes proposed Amazon data centre project
projects.notes: Proposed hyperscale data centre in Balkum, Thane, attributed to Amazon by the newspaper headline; no Amazon-issued record was probed. announced_year is the year of the earliest dated source captured (18 July 2026 protest report), not a confirmed announcement year. No capacity or investment is stated in the source. Coordinates are the Thane city centroid, not the site.

projects.name: AWS AI Zone, Ulsan (SK Group build-out)

projects.notes: The only source read is Buglife's 14 August 2025 news page, a campaign group's account, so Google's own plan documents and the Thurrock planning register were not checked and no application reference is recorded. Buglife says the campus would destroy over half of the Arena Essex Local Wildlife Site and over 80% of its Open Mosaic Habitat, and that over 2,500 supporters had signed a petition calling on Google to withdraw the plans. Status is announced pending a council decision; none was found. No site coordinates are recorded.

responses.summary: South Dublin County Council refused planning permission, citing concerns about the electricity network.
responses.source_title: Newstalk — Google refused permission to build huge Dublin data centre

responses.summary: Planning officers at Loughton Town Council called for a fresh planning application and objected that the revised scheme would require more cooling and increased energy.
responses.source_title: Data Centre Review — Nscale latest to face public backlash over proposed data centre

responses.summary: The newly elected mayor of Le Bourget is demanding cancellation of the 75 MW Segro data centre. The date is the article date.
responses.source_title: BeBeez — Mayor could block data center planned at former H&M warehouse in Le Bourget, France

responses.summary: The environmental authority MRAe queried the limited waste-heat recovery planned for the site. The date is the article date.
responses.source_title: BeBeez — Mayor could block data center planned at former H&M warehouse in Le Bourget, France

responses.summary: The Segundo Tribunal Ambiental partially upheld a challenge to the approval of the Cerrillos Data Center, ordered the environmental assessment service (SEA) to reopen the evaluation, and suspended the project until a complementary approval is issued. The date is the press report date, and the account is El Mostrador's reading of the ruling.
responses.source_title: El Mostrador — Tribunal pone freno a Google: Data Center debe incorporar cambio climático en evaluación ambiental

responses.summary: MOSACAT, a Cerrillos community group, opposes the Google project. Co-founder Tania Rodríguez says the project would have taken residents' water, and the group says it does not need more data centres in the area.
responses.source_title: El Salto — La fiebre de la IA y los centros de datos abre un nuevo frente por el agua en Chile

responses.summary: A Lane Cove council representative welcomed the withdrawal of the Project Mars application as a win for the community. The stance refers to the withdrawal, not to data centres in general. The date is the article date.
responses.source_title: ACS Information Age — Controversial Sydney data centre plan scrapped

responses.summary: Residents of Balkum, Thane, protested the proposed Amazon data centre, alleging inadequate public consultation and large water use; the Wake Up Thanekar group demanded transparency and wider consultation.
responses.source_title: Free Press Journal — Wake Up Thanekar representative opposes proposed Amazon data centre project

responses.summary: Svenska kraftnät's grid-development section manager says 750 megawatts is far too large a load for the local grid and that reinforcements are needed. Svenska kraftnät is the state transmission system operator, not the energy regulator, so 'regulator' is the closest available constituency; this is a technical statement on capacity, not an objection to the project.
responses.source_title: SVT Nyheter Sörmland — Lokala kraftnätet klarar inte enorma AI-satsningen i Strängnäs (8 Jun 2025)

responses.summary: The Segundo Tribunal Ambiental dismissed, in a ruling of 31 March 2026, a claim that the storage centre was linked to construction of the Huechuraba high-voltage line. The claim was an objection to the approval; the court's dismissal is the outcome.
responses.source_title: Forbes Chile — Justicia ambiental da luz verde al proyecto de data center de Amazon en Huechuraba (6 Apr 2026)

responses.summary: Corporación Ngen ran the 'Quili.AI' action in Quilicura on 31 January 2026, with residents answering questions in place of a chatbot to raise awareness of AI's water use. Its coordinator said the aim was to build awareness of the water impact of AI, not to oppose AI. The report counts six approved data centres in the commune, Google's among them, and an activist quoted in it singles out Google's site over its water rights; the action was not aimed at one operator.
responses.source_title: Radio Universidad de Chile — El agua que usa la IA es chilena: vecinos de Quilicura alegan "falta de responsabilidad" de data centers

responses.summary: Residents and campaigners want the land de-zoned before any planning application and call on Naas Municipal District councillors to seek a statutory variation of the local area plan. The Naas Municipal District mayor says pressure is building from residents.
responses.source_title: Kildare Nationalist: Kildare Microsoft data centre faces local opposition

responses.summary: A resident and Louth Environmental Group appealed Fingal County Council's grant of permission for the campus. The Commission's order of 19 December 2025, which grants permission subject to conditions including a Corporate PPA, records the appeal; it does not state when the appeal was lodged.
responses.source_title: An Coimisiún Pleanála — Commission Order ABP-318180-23

responses.summary: According to The Register (24 July 2026), residents at a meeting with Google's team about the Waltham Cross data centre raised noise (a hum in the evening), night-time lighting in bedrooms and poor consultation; a council representative said only 12 people attended the previous public meeting.
responses.source_title: The Register — Google meets the neighbors and gets both barrels over its new UK datacenter

responses.summary: Reported on 6 August 2026: activists and children have marched in Visakhapatnam city with banners reading “We cannot drink DATA”. The article says the marches took place in recent weeks and gives no dates.
responses.source_title: Reuters (via New Straits Times) — Google's US$15bil India data centre project battles water, wildlife concerns

responses.summary: Reported on 6 August 2026: Raja Rama Mohan Roy, founder of the non-profit Green Visakha, said at an event where he presented Visakhapatnam water supply and demand figures that development should not come at the cost of people's livelihoods. The event date is not stated.
responses.source_title: Reuters (via New Straits Times) — Google's US$15bil India data centre project battles water, wildlife concerns

responses.summary: Andhra Pradesh IT minister Nara Lokesh said in the state Assembly on 18 August 2026 that data-centre water will not be diverted from the city's existing water infrastructure and that additional water will come from Polavaram. This is the state government's position, not a community finding.
responses.source_title: The South First — Lokesh: no diversion of residential water for Vizag data centres

responses.summary: An Coimisiún Pleanála granted Google permission on appeal for the Grange Castle expansion, subject to conditions including evidence of engagement with power purchase agreements and renewable fuel for backup generators; the Irish Times reports the decision may face judicial review.
responses.source_title: The Irish Times — Google wins planning permission for Dublin data centre extension

responses.summary: The Next Web, reporting the Guardian's investigation, says the site's state environmental clearance covers 2.51 GW, more than double the 1 GW announced, that the state approved it in nine days with no public hearing, and that 520 families in Tarluvada recently had land taken back that the government had given them about 20 years earlier.
responses.source_title: The Next Web — Google's India AI hub cleared for 2.51GW, not 1GW, the Guardian reports

responses.summary: Hundreds of residents, including elderly people, gathered beside the Amazon site in Balkum on 8 September 2026 with placards against the project. Reuters interviewed more than two dozen residents, who worry about strain on local power and water and about noise. Amazon and local authorities say the project will not burden public utilities because water and power come from dedicated sources.
responses.source_title: Reuters (via Arab News) — Fearing power and water strain, residents fight Amazon data center near Mumbai

responses.summary: An Instagram reel by independent journalists with Tarluvada residents on the Google data centre was withheld in India from 22 May 2026 under a government blocking order. It was accessible again on 10 September 2026, with no reasons given for the block or its reversal.
responses.source_title: Internet Freedom Foundation — 'Dirty Data' reel on Google's Vizag data centre back online in India after 111-day takedown

responses.summary: Green Visakhapatnam, a non-profit, objected to the proposed 500 MW Vizag Hyperscale Data Centre, alleging environmental regulation violations and warning of risks to city water and public health. It says the 160 acres of Simhachalam Devasthanam land were allocated without an environmental impact assessment or public consultation.
responses.source_title: Deccan Chronicle — Green Visakhapatnam flags risks from data centre project

responses.summary: Dalit farmers in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam district, have refused to give up land for the Google AI hub, citing displacement from land allotted to Dalit families in the 1970s and compensation they call below market value. Reporting says the local Dalit community is divided over the project.
responses.source_title: The Business Standard — Giant data centre over land belonging to Dalits sparking protests in Andhra Pradesh

responses.summary: Activists in Andhra Pradesh are demanding a moratorium on new data centres across the state until independent environmental and social impact evaluations are published. The demand is reported in an AFP-sourced feature on resident fears over water, power and jobs at the Google Visakhapatnam hub.
responses.source_title: Malay Mail (AFP) — 'Why here?' India activists demand moratorium as Google's AI hub scars land and sparks water fears

responses.summary: Residents' group Wake Up Thanekar disputes the Balkum data centre's closed-loop, air-cooled water claim. Activists note Amazon disclosed a water need of 125 kilolitres a day while the municipal corporation has agreed to supply 12 million litres a day of recycled sewage water.
responses.source_title: Free Press Journal — Amazon defends Balkum hyperscale data centre as Thanekars demand its relocation

responses.summary: A protective wall at the under-construction Google-Adani site in Simhachalam-Mudasarlova collapsed on 22 September 2026 after heavy rain. Residents suspect construction has blocked natural drainage, which the report links to questions about the site's environmental clearances.
responses.source_title: The South First — Data center boundary wall collapses in Simhachalam; doubts raised over environmental clearances

responses.summary: The Human Rights Forum condemned the restriction in India of the 'Stop Vizag Data Centers' Instagram account, which the campaign says reached 56 lakh views and 11,800 followers in two months. HRF says posts by many organisations and individuals critical of AI data centres have been restricted in India.
responses.source_title: The South First — HRF condemns restriction of 'Stop Vizag Data Centers' Instagram account

responses.summary: Wallonia's Vice-President, quoted in Google's release, said the investment confirms Wallonia's role as a European data hub and creates digital-sector jobs. The statement is hosted on the company's release.
responses.source_title: Google Cloud Press Corner — Wallonia Vice-President Pierre-Yves Jeholet quoted in Google's Belgium release

responses.summary: In a Diario Financiero report dated 20 January 2021, reprinted by CPI Chile, the Environmental Assessment Service (SEA) is quoted as saying that no significant adverse impacts will be generated by the Cerrillos project. The Segundo Tribunal Ambiental partly annulled the approval in February 2024.
responses.source_title: CPI Chile — reprint of Diario Financiero on the SEA's response (20 Jan 2021)

responses.summary: Reuters, as syndicated by New Straits Times on 6 August 2026, reports that the Andhra Pradesh government called activists' concerns about the project incorrect and misleading. This is the state's position on the project, not an independent finding.
responses.source_title: Reuters via New Straits Times — Google's US$15bil India data centre project battles water, wildlife concerns

responses.summary: Reuters, as syndicated by New Straits Times on 6 August 2026, reports that Jal Biradari (Water Community) says the project will strain water availability by putting stress on a nearby reservoir. It is the group's allegation, not an independent measurement.
responses.source_title: Reuters via New Straits Times — Google's US$15bil India data centre project battles water, wildlife concerns

responses.summary: Per AFP and Reuters via Al Jazeera, Finland's environmental supervisory agency (LVV) ordered Tuike Finland, acting for Google, to suspend preparatory work at the planned Muhos and Kajaani sites no later than 23 October 2026, until mandatory environmental impact assessments are completed. The agency is checking whether hundreds of hectares of forest were cleared without one.
responses.source_title: Al Jazeera (AFP/Reuters) — Finland orders halt to work on Google data centre sites

responses.summary: AFP reports that the interim-relief judge of the Grenoble administrative court suspended the building permit granted to Sesterce pending a decision on the merits, citing the risk of damaging environmental effects that should have been examined before the permit was issued. A suspension is not an annulment.
responses.source_title: AFP via Connaissance des énergies — IA: la justice suspend un projet de centre de données près de Valence

responses.summary: Rest of World reports that 56 local residents petitioned against Microsoft in July 2023 over its Mekaguda data centre site near Hyderabad, alleging land occupied beyond the boundary and industrial waste dumped in a nearby lake. Microsoft told the outlet it complies with local requirements. The project record here is the Hyderabad cloud region, which this campus site may not exactly match; the date is the article's.
responses.source_title: Rest of World — Microsoft data centre India Mekaguda (20 Aug 2024)

responses.summary: Banque des Territoires reports that the Montreuil administrative court's interim-relief judge upheld the commune's withdrawal of Segro's building permit, finding the project did not comply with the local plan's height rules. It is a provisional measure; the merits are undecided and Segro says it will contest.
responses.source_title: Banque des Territoires — Datacenters: les projets contestés dans la Drôme et au Bourget

responses.summary: A spokesperson for Resistencia Socioambiental Quilicura said the data centre has a registered right to draw 50 litres per second from the aquifers that feed the Quilicura wetland, and that the companies lack responsibility. The same article carries Google's own 2024 water-use figure.
responses.source_title: Radio Universidad de Chile — El agua que usa la IA es chilena: vecinos de Quilicura alegan 'falta de responsabilidad' de data centers (4 Mar 2026)

responses.summary: A campaign page by the Migrano de Arena coalition says it filed an appeal with the High Court of Justice of Aragon (TSJA) against Amazon's PIGA covering five campuses. The date shown is the page's publication date, because the filing date is not stated.
responses.source_title: Migrano de Arena — appeal to the TSJA against the AWS PIGA (campaign page)

responses.summary: Thane MP Naresh Mhaske submitted a memorandum to the Thane Municipal Corporation commissioner and the District Collector demanding an immediate stay, alleging tree felling at the Amazon site exceeded the permissions granted. The allegation is his own and not a finding.
responses.source_title: Free Press Journal — Thane MP Naresh Mhaske demands immediate halt on Amazon data centre

responses.summary: Wildlife charity Buglife wrote to Google UK objecting that the campus would destroy over half of the Arena Essex Local Wildlife Site and over 80% of its Open Mosaic Habitat, and its campaign reported over 2,500 petition signatures asking Google to withdraw the plans.
responses.source_title: Buglife: Google plans for sprawling data centre campus on designated wildlife site

rate_cases.title: Hydro-Québec's proposed data-centre rate (tarif CD)
rate_cases.next_milestone: Hearings scheduled 7–11 December and 15–18 December 2026 (after sessions held 1–9 October), per the docket.
rate_cases.summary: Hydro-Québec Distribution asked the Régie de l'énergie to set a new rate for data centres (tarif CD), together with an adjustment to the rate for cryptographic blockchain use. Hydro-Québec says the rate is equivalent to an average of 13¢/kWh, approximately double what current large-power customers pay, and is subject to the Régie's approval. The Régie lists the docket as ongoing ("En cours"). Hydro-Québec's release states the rate applies to data centres requiring a capacity greater than 5 MW and is expected to take effect in the second half of 2026, subject to approval by the Régie.
rate_cases.source_title: Régie de l'énergie — Dossier R-4333-2026 (HQD, tarifs centres de données)
